snippet.title: Age of Mythology: Retold - Heavenly Spear |  Launch Trailer | Tokyo Game Show 2025
snippet.description:
A New Pantheon Rises. A Legend Awakens.

Command the gods, heroes, and yokai of Japan in Heavenly Spear, an all-new expansion for Age of Mythology: Retold. 

Play a sweeping campaign, wield the powers of mighty Japanese gods, and command samurai and mythical yokai to achieve victory.  

Available September 30, 2025!
